item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q012_not_true_family_specific_pair","answer":"Yes—in the SCOPe 2.08 classification sense. d1s9za_ (Amyloidogenic design-1) and d1hqja_ (Unnamed design-1) share family k.40.1.1, “Designed trimeric coiled-coil” (SUNID 100905); this family-level relationship supports homology more strongly than merely sharing a superfamily or fold. They remain distinct protein nodes, however, and both are synthetic designs, so this classification should not be interpreted uncritically as natural common ancestry.
